payload.title: Markus-brand sites must not enumerate Next reader static params (CMS build fails)
payload.description: Pilobol.us CMS Amplify app dv0pdx67fk80m builds fail since scaffold PR #50: generateArticleStaticParams in lib/reader-static-params.ts lists CMS article slugs from GraphQL (now non-empty), but app/articles/[slug]/page.tsx throws MarkusSiteRendererError for Markus brands during prerender. Job 5 (next.12) had no slugs, 5 pages; job 7 (next.15) 15 pages, fails on /articles/believe-the-rainbow. Fix: both static-params generators return [] for Markus brands.
